title: On the Kobayashi isometries of a class of 2-dimensional Lempert manifolds
summary: We prove that every Kobayashi distance isometry between $2$-dimensional Lempert manifolds having finite universal set (with atleast three elements) is holomorphic or anti-holomorphic. It is shown that every such isometry is $C_{loc}^{1,1}$ without any regularity assumption on the isometry.
